items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: Christian McBride used to come into my store when he was a kid. Okay? When he was a young kid.

ctx.x: What kind of records would Sun Ra have been looking for?

He would look at — he would go to the Fletcher Henderson section first. And then he would go to the Duke Ellington section. But he never bought anything. He just looked. Christian McBride used to come into my store when he was a kid. Okay? When he was a young kid. He would do the same thing. There’s plenty of people that would just go through the stacks and it was a, you know, wanting to see what was happening. I really eventually tried to have every jazz record in print and out of print, cutouts, which were part…
Was he dressed as we are, as we remember him, in performance garb?
